major_findings.summary: The toast duration was changed from a range to an unsupported exact time.
major_findings.evidence: The candidate records "3.5 min", while the original specifies "3..5 min". This removes the original two-minute timing range and asserts a particular duration not present in the recipe.

rationale: The title, yield, ingredients, single operation, topology, and final output are correct, but the only operation's duration is materially mistranscribed. Because an exact 3.5-minute instruction is not equivalent to the original 3-to-5-minute range, the reconstruction is not semantically equivalent.
